title: A pedigree that shows X-linked recessive inheritance
caption: Only males are affected, and the allele reaches them through carrier mothers: I-2 has an affected son and a carrier daughter (II-2), who in turn has an affected son. Unaffected parents with an affected child rule out a dominant allele.
alt: A three-generation family tree: carrier mother I-2 has an affected son II-1; her carrier daughter II-2 has an affected son III-1.
description: Squares are males, circles females, filled symbols affected, a dot marks a carrier.
I-1 and I-2 are unaffected but have an affected son, II-1: not dominant.
Only males are affected, and each affected male has a carrier mother.
If the allele is X-linked recessive, I-2 and II-2 must be carriers (XᴬXᵃ).
